rsxr: R bindings for the rsx RAD-seq sex-determination toolkit

Source: R/rsxr-package.R
rsxr-package.Rd

rsxr binds the rsx C API directly through R's native C interface. The low-level functions (rsx_process(), rsx_freq(), rsx_distrib(), rsx_signif(), rsx_triage(), rsx_depth(), rsx_merge(), rsx_pca()) mirror the rsx CLI one to one. The high-level marker_table() workflow returns tibbles.
